episodes.title: The Goldfish Problem
episodes.summary: Steven Grant learns that he may be a superhero, but may also share a body with a ruthless mercenary.

episodes.title: Summon the Suit
episodes.summary: With little time to react, Steven is thrust into a war of the gods as a mysterious partner arrives.

episodes.title: The Friendly Type
episodes.summary: With Marc in the forefront and Harrow near Ammit's tomb, Marc needs to navigate Cairo while putting his differences aside with Layla and Steven without jeopardizing their mission.

episodes.title: The Tomb
episodes.summary: Marc & Steven trek the Siwa Desert with Layla to find Ammit's tomb, but the threats ahead look to protect the goddess' resting place.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.summary: Marc & Steven search through their memories to find their truth or become left behind.

episodes.title: Gods and Monsters
episodes.summary: As Moon Knight joins the fray, Marc, Steven, and Khonshu must work together to stop Ammit.
